ALICIA INVESTS / FREE WEBSITE EXAMPLE

Give yourself a ten-minute check-in.

A small routine to keep the next few days visible.

  1. Check the balances you actually have available.
  2. List the bills due in the next seven days.
  3. Review one unexpected or recurring cost.
  4. Write one next action and when you will do it.

Your next action: __________________________
